name: Continental Aerospace Technologies Holding Limited
summary: Continental Aerospace Technologies Holding Limited (HK) Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the design, development, and production of general aviation aircraft piston engines and spare parts in the United States, Europe, and internationally. It also provides repair and maintenance services for aircraft engines, as well as supports for piston engines. The company was formerly known as CATIC International Holdings Limited and changed its name to Continental Aerospace Technologies Holding Limited (HK) Limited in June 2009. Continental Aerospace Technologies Holding Limited (HK) Limited was incorporated in 1992 and is headquartered in Hong Kong, Hong Kong.
